summary: Belle & Bloom is a Sydney women's fashion and handbag brand selling through its own site, retail partners such as Myer and more than 10 North American marketplaces via Mirakl Connect. Lan Yu has been the company's Accountant since March 2014, with a very small team around her.

sources.title: How belle & bloom expanded globally with Mirakl Connect
Belle & Bloom secures Myer after 300% growth

claims.text: Belle & Bloom is a Sydney-established brand selling an international range online.
claims.quote: Established in Sydney in 2016, belle & bloom is an international lifestyle brand of accessible luxury pieces designed for modern women.

claims.text: Lan Yu is Accountant at Belle & Bloom, current since March 2014.
Lan Yu is also listed as Accountant at Mosmann Australia, a related retailer.
Belle & Bloom onboarded more than 10 North American marketplaces in four years via Mirakl Connect.
claims.quote: successfully onboarded more than 10 North American marketplaces in 4 years.

claims.text: CEO Sherry Wu said US selling offsets Australia's slower seasons, and vice versa.
claims.quote: increasing sales in the United States during Australia's slower times, and vice versa

claims.text: Before Mirakl Connect, Belle & Bloom managed each marketplace independently.
claims.quote: Before joining Mirakl Connect, belle & bloom managed each marketplace they operated on independently.

claims.text: In 2019 Belle & Bloom signed a store and online deal with Myer after 300% sales growth.
claims.quote: Belle & Bloom has now inked an expansive top store and online deal

claims.text: LinkedIn's tech profile lists Shopify and Mirakl among its tools.
claims.quote: Tech Stack: klaviyo, mailchimp, mirakl, salesforce, shopify, amp, adobe

claims.text: Belle & Bloom onboarded over 2,500 SKUs across multiple marketplaces.
claims.quote: belle & bloom seamlessly onboarded over 2,500 SKUs across multiple marketplaces

claims.text: It sells through its own eCommerce site and retail partners' online platforms and physical stores.
claims.quote: They sell their products worldwide through their own eCommerce website and their retail partners' online platforms and physical stores.

hooks.text: Multi-marketplace selling (10+ North American marketplaces) plus retail partners means many separate payouts for one accountant to reconcile.
Selling in opposite seasons across Australia and the US shifts payout and FX timing.

risks.text: Very small team (LinkedIn lists 9 employees, finance headcount 1) and Lan Yu also listed at Mosmann Australia, so time may be shared. Myer deal source is from 2019.

gaps: No posts, podcasts or job ads from Lan Yu or Belle & Bloom finance found.
Company founding year differs between sources (2010 vs 2016).
